paragraphs.content: Let me start by saying that I know this is a lot, but idk I enjoyed every second of it in a purely personal capacity as much as the social one between us, which I suppose occurs once you look at this. Nevertheless, the act of making this, laborious as it was, it was an act in practicing my love for you, and there is hardly anything else i would rather spend my life doing than that. I love you, and that is a fact, unchanged and unchanging. This website is just a bunch of media, namely a bunch of rare-ish books I found including one whic is this weird almost psychological text called the cloud of unknowing which has its origins in christianity and it talks about the self, one about the sun which i thought was pretty cool, madonna in a fur coat because i feel you’d probably like that type of story, and a few others which i thought were interesting. Outside of that I made you a playlist! Its got a lot of different types of music, a lot of electronic stuff, specifically Aphex Twin, but also a lot of jazz.

The essays are just for your eyes. I just wanted to tell you things because I cant exactly think of many people, per se, to just tell things in general, actually, as much as you. They kind of turned into these rants, and I highkey wish I had had a less intense week and as a result of that the time and peace of mind necessary to actually write, but well, I played with the cards i was dealt. I had a lot of fun developing the image thing, which i wanted to be kind of like Pinterest initially but i felt like the random image placement would be more fun and interesting, kind of like just fridge magnets or an artboard or something. Thats about it for the website, I did get you one other thing but you’ll find out about that when you find out about that :). I love you and I’ve missed you so much over the course of this last week, I find myself thinking about you constantly and this website has been a great outlet lol.

Im dealing with this set of circumstances really rather well compared to before and I think i can just chalk that up to timing in how ive been getting better in general and your patience with me too, in how you’ve kind of just bieen there and been so kind always. Im trying to and I will be better. A lot of my insecurities around this particular thing have to do with how i view myself, the love i believe i deserve and dont and even how i talk to myself, theres a lot here in that sense that I need to tell you and I will when we just hangout for a day sometime. Ive said this before and I can say it again; i dont think i could ever be with someone the way ive been in this relationship, there is a certain clarity that i feel when im with you, its damn near miraculous the effect you seem to have on me, even if i am mentally ill when it comes to the fact that I love you, and that I cherish you, your presnce and your being with as much love I have in drawing breaths or drinking water. It is purely transcendental, and it entirely escapes my imagination as to why this might be the case, but it is and I'm happy to be here. I love you, Bhavishya :)
